role: Extension of TrainingMetricsCache holding the rebuild rule: load settings that force a rebuild, the HistoricalKey a series build depends on, throttle constants, and a SHA-256 fingerprint of HealthKit workouts.
types: TrainingMetricsCache.LoadSettings: struct Codable — restingHR, maxHR, isFemale, ftp anchors
TrainingMetricsCache.HistoricalKey: struct — archive/healthKit fingerprints, day, settings, anchors

units.does: Captures effective resting/max HR, female flag and the current FTP anchors (manual FTP or FTPAutoEstimator cache) from settings.

Pure rebuild rule: true when there is no result or lastUpdated is nil (dirty); true at once when the load settings or the day changed (dayChanged defaults to false); otherwise true when the result's age exceeds burstThrottleSec (300 s) if the archived workouts changed, else unchangedMaxAgeSec (1800 s).

branches.effect: age compared with burstThrottleSec; else with unchangedMaxAgeSec

units.does: SHA-256 hex over each HK workout (sorted by start) of start epoch, duration, type, averageHR (or -1), precomputedLoad (or -1).

branches.cond: for each workout sorted by date
